summary: This bill reauthorizes appropriations for the Water Resources Research Act of 1984 through fiscal year 2029, allocating $16,000,000 annually for water resources research and technology institutes, with 20 percent specifically for research on interstate water problems, and updates the congressional declaration of purpose to include the artificial intelligence industry.

scores.thoughts: This bill reauthorizes appropriations for water resources research and technology institutes, specifically authorizing $16,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2029. This directly involves government spending.

The bill focuses on water resources research and technology, which inherently relates to environmental concerns and the management of natural resources. The research aims to address water problems, contributing to environmental protection.

The bill authorizes $16 million annually for FY2026–2029 to fund water resources research institutes, creating new federal spending without any offsets or revenue provisions. This has only a tangential relationship to deficit reduction because the spending is a minor component of a bill whose primary purpose is reauthorizing and updating a research program.
